_comment: Full stdio profile: every optional product starter enabled read-only (ClearPass, Mist, Apstra, AOS8, EdgeConnect, UXI, Axis, Design) alongside the always-on core/glp/rag/interop backends. Router still exposes only find_tool/invoke_read_tool/invoke_tool in minimal mode -- HPE_MCP_PRODUCTS only changes what the router can reach, not the client-visible tool count. Set HPE_MCP_PRODUCT_ACCESS=read-write only for a trusted lab session that needs guarded write tools visible. Replace /path/to/hpe-networking-mcp with your local clone path.
